Who we are

Built on bikes.
Bound by brotherhood.

DARKRIDERS Bengaluru brings motorcycle enthusiasts together through group rides, friendships and a shared respect for the road.

🏍️

The ride comes first

From city routes to open highways, every ride is a chance to explore, learn and enjoy the journey together.

🤝

A crew, not a crowd

We welcome riders who value friendship, mutual respect and looking out for everyone in the group.

🛣️

Respect the road

Responsible riding, proper gear and disciplined group formation are part of our riding culture.

Next chapter starts here

Make every kilometre count.

Meet fellow riders, discover new routes around Bengaluru and create stories worth telling. Ride plans and meet-up details can be shared with the community.

Our riding code

Good rides start
with good habits.

The best ride is the one where everyone gets home safely. That's the standard we ride by.

✓
Wear your riding gearHelmet and suitable protective gear on every ride.
✓
Follow traffic rulesNo racing, stunts or dangerous behaviour on public roads.
✓
Ride as a groupKeep safe distance, follow ride briefings and support fellow riders.
✓
Respect everyoneBe considerate to other road users, communities and fellow members.
